'''Lucilla''' is a female NPC found near the [[Titanbone Expanse]] arena. She is the mother of a gladiator named [[Magnus]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:'''Lucilla''': Greetings, visitor. I'm guessing you're visiting Septimont to watch the Agon?
:'''Lucilla''': Let me tell you something. My son's a Gladiator and his next match is about to begin. When you're visiting Septimont, always make the Colosseum your first stop.
:'''Lucilla''': Otherwise, you'd be wasting time on those pointless painters and musicians with all their pointless rumblings in Fountain Square.
----
;(After completing {{Quest|Flames of Heart}})
:'''Lucilla''': Greetings, visitor. Remember me? I was shocked to hear discussions of how you've become the champion!
:{{DIcon}} You're not into gladiating anymore?
:'''Lucilla''': Yes, I haven't been watching the tournaments much lately. My [[Magnus|son]] has found an amazing {{tt|mentor|Cecila}}, and he's on track to becoming a great singer soon!
:'''Lucilla''': You should visit Fountain Square when you have time. It'll sure attract an audience with the champion around.
{{Dialogue End}}
